title: [ingest] PreToolUse gate blocks Write/Edit without an in_progress claim — but fails OPEN
summary: orch-gate.sh denies (exit 2) inline file edits unless this session holds an in_progress task. It fails OPEN if the daemon is unreachable (never bricks editing on outage), is bypassed by ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 or sessions/<id>.off, and deliberately does NOT exempt orchestrator SOURCE (~/.claude/orchestrator/**) — that source IS the substantive work the gate routes. Memory/settings/CLAUDE.md/.mcp.json/tmp paths are allowlisted.
